metadata.description: Source registry for verifying agricultural information used by AgriSathi.
metadata.verification_policy: Every agricultural claim must be checked against a relevant source before being presented as verified.
metadata.chemical_safety_policy: Chemical products, application rates, dosage, and waiting periods must not be recommended without appropriate authoritative verification.

sources.name: Indian Council of Agricultural Research
sources.notes: Use relevant ICAR publications and research resources. Verify the specific publication and its applicability to the crop and region.

sources.name: Indian Institute of Soil Science
sources.notes: Use relevant publications for soil properties, soil health, and nutrient management.

sources.name: Indian Institute of Horticultural Research
sources.notes: Consult crop-specific horticultural publications and recommendations.

sources.name: Indian Institute of Rice Research
sources.notes: Use rice-specific research publications and recommendations where relevant.

sources.name: Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research
sources.notes: Use relevant wheat and barley publications for crop-specific recommendations.

sources.name: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine and Storage
sources.notes: Consult relevant official pesticide registrations, regulatory information, and plant-protection resources. Registration alone does not establish that a product is suitable for a particular crop, pest, or use.

sources.name: Central Insecticides Board and Registration Committee
sources.notes: Verify the exact product, formulation, crop, target pest, approved application method, and label directions. Never infer dosage from a general pest-control statement.

sources.name: India Meteorological Department
sources.notes: Use current forecasts and relevant agrometeorological advisories. Record the location, issue time, and validity period.

sources.name: ICAR Agricultural Technology Application Research Institute Network
sources.notes: Use advisories from the relevant regional network or associated Krishi Vigyan Kendra. The registry URL is the ICAR homepage; locate the specific regional publication before citing a claim.

sources.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.notes: Use relevant ministry publications and official scheme information. Policy information should include its applicable date.

sources.name: Agricultural Marketing Information Network
sources.notes: Use matching commodity, market, date, and price type. Clearly distinguish minimum, maximum, and modal prices.

sources.name: National Informatics Centre - Open Government Data Platform
sources.notes: Record the dataset resource identifier, retrieval timestamp, and relevant fields when using API data. Check that the returned records match the requested crop and market.

sources.name: Soil Health Card Portal
sources.notes: Crop nutrient recommendations should consider the farmer's soil-test results and applicable regional guidance.

sources.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra Network
sources.notes: Prefer the KVK serving the farmer's district. Store the exact advisory title, publishing institution, date, and URL.

sources.name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.notes: Use relevant technical publications as supporting references. Prefer applicable Indian and regional recommendations when they are available.
